#!/usr/bin/env bash
max=1024
min=1
# function to guess a number and get response
function guess(){
    local n=$1
    ./guess.py $n
}
# repeat guess 3 times and majority
function reliable_guess(){
    local n=$1
    local a=$(guess $n)
    local b=$(guess $n)
    local c=$(guess $n)
    echo $a $b $c
}
# perform binary search 5 levels
for ((i=0;i<5;i++)); do
    mid=$(( (min+max)/2 ))
    read a b c < <(reliable_guess $mid)
    # majority vote
    if [[ $a == "equals" || $b == "equals" || $c == "equals" ]]; then
        ans=$mid
        break
    fi
    # count higher/lower
    higher=$(( (a=="higher") + (b=="higher") + (c=="higher") ))
    lower=$(( (a=="lower") + (b=="lower") + (c=="lower") ))
    if (( higher > lower )); then
        # target higher
        min=$((mid+1))
    else
        # target lower
        max=$((mid-1))
    fi
    echo "After step $((i+1)): range $min-$max"
    # check if range collapsed
    if (( min>=max )); then
        ans=$min
        break
    fi
done
# submit answer
./guess.py $ans > /dev/null
